test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank in the following sentence.**

The car ______ into the truck.
solution: The correct answer is "bashed." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "bashed" means to hit somebody/something very hard. ((किसी से) ज़ोर से टकरा जाना) • Example:* I didn’t stop in time and **bashed**__ into the car in front.* • The word** "bashed"** is appropriate in this context as it conveys a sense of forceful impact or collision between the car and the truck. • It implies a strong and possibly violent contact, emphasizing the severity of the collision. • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. Correct sentence:* **The car __**bashed**__ into the truck.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **Stripped: **to take off your clothes; to take off somebody else’s clothes. (अपने कपड़े उतार लेना; दूसरे के कपड़े उतार देना) • **Bounded: **to run quickly with long steps. (लंबे डग भरते हुए तेज़ दौड़ना) • **Decked: **one of the floors of a ship or bus. (जलपोत या बस की कोई भी मंज़िल, डेक) 1e8:Tdbe, The correct answer is **"Feeling extremely nervous."**
